change: Drag/drop metadata classification runs on one background worker with one queued request. Later drops supersede queued work; later gallery/folder/image navigation cancels pending inspection. Folder results remain queued while inspection is pending, so rejecting an invalid drop preserves previous folder context. File/folder intake and symlink/unsupported/special-file refusal policies are preserved.

metal_callback_with_blocked_inspection.scope: Actual Metal required; upload budget reaches zero while controlled drop-metadata worker is still blocked.

limitations: Blocked metadata uses synchronized test channels, not physical slow storage.
A blocked OS metadata call can still delay this worker and its one queued request; UI submission/polling does not wait for it.
No native OS drag gesture or post-change viewer-window observation.
Intake tests classify PNG/OBJ file paths; they do not qualify their decoding or all 100 formats.
CLI initial-path regular-file validation remains synchronous before the UI loop.
This does not qualify physical HDR color or NVIDIA hardware.
